ModMetaData.name: Yayo Animation 1.7 + Tick Fix
ModMetaData.author: YAYO, Soky
ModMetaData.description:
Yayo Animation 1.7 + Tick Fix Original animations by YAYO. Continued version by Soky. Tick Overflow Fix by ifchen0.
Changes in this package
- RimWorld 1.7 compatibility, including a new-game animation-cache reset correction. - Includes ifchen0's Tick Overflow Fix. Negative animation frames caused by large tick counts or pawn IDs are converted to valid non-negative frames in the standing and laying animation code. - Includes ifchen0's custom-job facing repair: indefinitely cached standing-job results refresh when the pawn turns through Pawn.Rotation or FaceTarget(). Scheduled animations and lying poses keep their chosen facing. - Already-valid remainder results are unchanged. The existing explicit-assembly startup and lifecycle fixes are retained. - Requires Harmony. Enable this package only: do not also enable Yayo's Animation (Continued) or the separate Tick Overflow Fix.
The tick correction addresses broken work, social, idle and other job animations, including distorted burning-and-rolling motion. High pawn IDs can trigger the issue even before a colony becomes old.
Tested locally on RimWorld 1.7.4982 rev1280 / Harmony 3: 37 native checks passed, including a real custom JobDriver turning in all four directions through both APIs before and after save/reload, and preservation of scheduled-animation facing. The ten existing hooks, 21 remainder replacements and 1,080 arithmetic cases passed. This new DLL is native 1.7 only; older version folders are unchanged. Prepatcher-enabled operation and the full player mod stack remain untested. Back up your save before a first playtest.
Original mod by Yayo! This is an update. You can find the original here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2575938407
Changes from original — inherited Continued-version description The following feature and compatibility notes are retained from Soky's Workshop description; third-party integrations have not all been re-tested for this 1.7 package.
- Updated to 1.4, while also bringing all those improvements to 1.3 as well - Added animation to new interactions that previously had none - No longer depending on HugsLib - Improved performance in a couple of places - Added several options that can help with performance - Built-in fix for Humanoid Alien Races - Fix for stargazing - Fix for Facial Animation - Support for (basically) all Vanilla Expanded mods and their interactions - Support for Dubs mods: Bad Hygiene, Rimefeller, Rimatomics, Paint Shop
Add Animation for Pawns Animations can be individually turned off in the options menu. Use only the animations you want.
Marriage Ceremony Burning & Roll Joy Funeral Lovin Work Walk Sleep Eat Weapon
And Others About 90 actions are animated. (almost every action)
>> Yayo's Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfrw-AKo2Ax-TnDXNmhE28w The latest news about Yayo's mods are posted on YouTube. Subscribe to YouTube and be the first to know.
Options
- Walk Animation Angle - Walk Animation Speed - Animations can be individually turned on/off.
